verses.en: He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.
verses.pt: Aquele que, sendo muitas vezes repreendido, endurece a cerviz, será quebrantado de repente sem que haja cura.
verses.en_web: He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.
verses.en_bbe: A man hating sharp words and making his heart hard, will suddenly be broken and will not be made well again.

verses.en: When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice: but when the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn.
verses.pt: Quando os justos governam, alegra-se o povo; mas quando o ímpio domina, o povo geme.
verses.en_web: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verses.en_bbe: When the upright have power, the people are glad; when an evil man is ruler, grief comes on the people.

verses.en: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father: but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance.
verses.pt: O que ama a sabedoria alegra a seu pai; mas o companheiro de prostitutas desperdiça a sua riqueza.
verses.en_web: Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.
verses.en_bbe: A man who is a lover of wisdom is a joy to his father: but he who goes in the company of loose women is a waster of wealth.

verses.en: The king by judgment establisheth the land: but he that receiveth gifts overthroweth it.
verses.pt: O rei pela justiça estabelece a terra; mas o que exige presentes a transtorna.
verses.en_web: The king by justice makes the land stable, but he who takes bribes tears it down.
verses.en_bbe: A king, by right rule, makes the land safe; but one full of desires makes it a waste.

verses.en: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet.
verses.pt: O homem que lisonjeia a seu próximo arma-lhe uma rede aos passos.
verses.en_web: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.
verses.en_bbe: A man who says smooth things to his neighbour is stretching out a net for his steps.

verses.en: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare: but the righteous doth sing and rejoice.
verses.pt: Na transgressão do homem mau há laço; mas o justo canta e se regozija.
verses.en_web: An evil man is snared by his sin, but the righteous can sing and be glad.
verses.en_bbe: In the steps of an evil man there is a net for him, but the upright man gets away quickly and is glad.

verses.en: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor: but the wicked regardeth not to know it.
verses.pt: O justo toma conhecimento da causa dos pobres; mas o ímpio não tem entendimento para a conhecer.
verses.en_web: The righteous care about justice for the poor. The wicked aren’t concerned about knowledge.
verses.en_bbe: The upright man gives attention to the cause of the poor: the evil-doer gives no thought to it.

verses.en: Scornful men bring a city into a snare: but wise men turn away wrath.
verses.pt: Os escarnecedores abrasam a cidade; mas os sábios desviam a ira.
verses.en_web: Mockers stir up a city, but wise men turn away anger.
verses.en_bbe: Men of pride are the cause of violent acts in a town, but by wise men wrath is turned away.

verses.en: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.
verses.pt: O sábio que pleiteia com o insensato, quer este se agaste quer se ria, não terá descanso.
verses.en_web: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.
verses.en_bbe: If a wise man goes to law with a foolish man, he may be angry or laughing, but there will be no rest.

verses.en: The bloodthirsty hate the upright: but the just seek his soul.
verses.pt: Os homens sanguinários odeiam o íntegro; mas os retos procuram o seu bem.
verses.en_web: The bloodthirsty hate a man of integrity; and they seek the life of the upright.
verses.en_bbe: Men of blood are haters of the good man, and evil-doers go after his soul.

verses.en: A fool uttereth all his mind: but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.
verses.pt: O tolo derrama toda a sua ira; mas o sábio a reprime e aplaca.
verses.en_web: A fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control.
verses.en_bbe: A foolish man lets out all his wrath, but a wise man keeps it back quietly.

verses.en: If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are wicked.
verses.pt: O governador que dá atenção às palavras mentirosas achará que todos os seus servos são ímpios.
verses.en_web: If a ruler listens to lies, all of his officials are wicked.
verses.en_bbe: If a ruler gives attention to false words, all his servants are evil-doers.

verses.en: The poor and the deceitful man meet together: the LORD lighteneth both their eyes.
verses.pt: O pobre e o opressor se encontram; o Senhor alumia os olhos de ambos.
verses.en_web: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: Yahweh gives sight to the eyes of both.
verses.en_bbe: The poor man and his creditor come face to face: the Lord gives light to their eyes equally.

verses.en: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.
verses.pt: Se o rei julgar os pobres com eqüidade, o seu trono será estabelecido para sempre.
verses.en_web: The king who fairly judges the poor, his throne shall be established forever.
verses.en_bbe: The king who is a true judge in the cause of the poor, will be safe for ever on the seat of his power.

verses.en: The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame.
verses.pt: A vara e a repreensão dão sabedoria; mas a criança entregue a si mesma envergonha a sua mãe.
verses.en_web: The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.
verses.en_bbe: The rod and sharp words give wisdom: but a child who is not guided is a cause of shame to his mother.

verses.en: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increaseth: but the righteous shall see their fall.
verses.pt: Quando os ímpios se multiplicam, multiplicam-se as transgressões; mas os justos verão a queda deles.
verses.en_web: When the wicked increase, sin increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.
verses.en_bbe: When evil men are in power, wrongdoing is increased; but the upright will have pleasure when they see their downfall.

verses.en: Correct thy son, and he shall give thee rest; yea, he shall give delight unto thy soul.
verses.pt: Corrige a teu filho, e ele te dará descanso; sim, deleitará o teu coração.
verses.en_web: Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul.
verses.en_bbe: Give your son training, and he will give you rest; he will give delight to your soul.

verses.en: Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.
verses.pt: Onde não há profecia, o povo se corrompe; mas o que guarda a lei esse é bem-aventurado.
verses.en_web: Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; but one who keeps the law is blessed.
verses.en_bbe: Where there is no vision, the people are uncontrolled; but he who keeps the law will be happy.

verses.en: A servant will not be corrected by words: for though he understand he will not answer.
verses.pt: O servo não se emendará com palavras; porque, ainda que entenda, não atenderá.
verses.en_web: A servant can’t be corrected by words. Though he understands, yet he will not respond.
verses.en_bbe: A servant will not be trained by words; for though the sense of the words is clear to him, he will not give attention.

verses.en: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
verses.pt: Vês um homem precipitado nas suas palavras? Maior esperança há para o tolo do que para ele.
verses.en_web: Do you see a man who is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
verses.en_bbe: Have you seen a man who is quick with his tongue? There is more hope for a foolish man than for him.

verses.en: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length.
verses.pt: Aquele que cria delicadamente o seu servo desde a meninice, no fim tê-lo-á por herdeiro.
verses.en_web: He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.
verses.en_bbe: If a servant is gently cared for from his early years, he will become a cause of sorrow in the end.

verses.en: An angry man stirreth up strife, and a furious man aboundeth in transgression.
verses.pt: O homem iracundo levanta contendas, e o furioso multiplica as transgressões.
verses.en_web: An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.
verses.en_bbe: An angry man is the cause of fighting, and a man given to wrath does much wrong.

verses.en: A man’s pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.
verses.pt: A soberba do homem o abaterá; mas o humilde de espírito obterá honra.
verses.en_web: A man’s pride brings him low, but one of lowly spirit gains honor.
verses.en_bbe: A man's pride will be the cause of his fall, but he who has a gentle spirit will get honour.

verses.en: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul: he heareth cursing, and bewrayeth it not.
verses.pt: O que é sócio do ladrão odeia a sua própria alma; sendo ajuramentado, nada denuncia.
verses.en_web: Whoever is an accomplice of a thief is an enemy of his own soul. He takes an oath, but dares not testify.
verses.en_bbe: A man who takes part with a thief has hate for his soul; he is put under oath, but says nothing.

verses.en: The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe.
verses.pt: O receio do homem lhe arma laços; mas o que confia no Senhor está seguro.
verses.en_web: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in Yahweh is kept safe.
verses.en_bbe: The fear of man is a cause of danger: but whoever puts his faith in the Lord will have a safe place on high.

verses.en: Many seek the ruler’s favour; but every man’s judgment cometh from the LORD.
verses.pt: Muitos buscam o favor do príncipe; mas é do Senhor que o homem recebe a justiça.
verses.en_web: Many seek the ruler’s favor, but a man’s justice comes from Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: The approval of a ruler is desired by great numbers: but the decision in a man's cause comes from the Lord.

verses.en: An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked.
verses.pt: O ímpio é abominação para os justos; e o que é reto no seu caminho é abominação para o ímpio.
verses.en_web: A dishonest man detests the righteous, and the upright in their ways detest the wicked.
verses.en_bbe: An evil man is disgusting to the upright, and he who is upright is disgusting to evil-doers.
